title: Betz limit
references: Betz, A., Das Maximum der theoretisch möglichen Ausnützung des Windes durch Windmotoren, Zeitschrift für das gesamte Turbinenwesen 26, 307-309 (1920)
validity_domain: Actuator disk in steady, incompressible, unconfined axial flow; power taken from the wind through the stated reference area.
limitations: Ideal rotor without wake rotation, drag or tip losses
Does not hold for a shrouded rotor if the power is divided by the rotor area only
A bound of the model, not a figure that real turbines reach
